answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an orchard bet on surviving 64 epochs of grading, and every terrace settlement recomputes the atlas schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 64 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
